race.comment: BARRENGARRY (2) held in high regard by the stable and can raise the bar again. Covered a stack of ground in the run first up with an arrogant victory over 1400m here. Will be even stronger out to the 1600m and Lloyd retains the ride. Should stamp his authority again. JUST IN TIME (5) yet to win past 1400m but gets another chance here at her fifth run in. Not that far away when seventh in BM78 grade behind Transcend over 1500m at Rosehill. A repeat effort keeps her in the contest. ALL STAR (11) underrated entire who was six weeks between runs with a fast-finishing victory over 1400m at Hawkesbury as a well-supported fav. Can hold his own in this company from the rails draw. Solid each-way contender. DUSTY BAY (6) not even J Mac could get the best out of him last start with a plugging fourth over 1400m at this track. Gets one more chance over the 1600m. Place only. FEDERAL RESERVE (8) rounded up a handy field two back over 1550m at Canterbury. Battled to see the 1800m out last start.
